class.name: Wheel
class.brief_description: A vehicle wheel with suspension raycasting, tanh-based tire forces, and self-aligning torque.
class.description: Wheel is a [Node3D] that represents a single wheel of a vehicle. It creates and manages a [RayCast3D] child node for suspension simulation, and uses a tanh-based tire model for smooth, progressive lateral and longitudinal force generation. Each Wheel should be a child of an [Axle] node.

method.name: get_suspension_rebound_force
method.description: Returns the current suspension rebound force in Newtons, calculated from spring compression and damper velocity.

method.name: get_angular_velocity
method.description: Returns the wheel's angular velocity in radians per second.

method.name: get_tire_force
method.description: Returns the tire force (world-space) applied to the vehicle last physics frame, averaged across substeps.

method.name: get_reaction_torque
method.description: Returns the drivetrain reaction torque at this wheel from longitudinal tire forces.

method.name: get_collision_point
method.description: Returns the world-space position where the wheel contacts the ground surface.

method.name: get_collision_normal
method.description: Returns the world-space surface normal at the wheel's contact point.

method.name: is_on_ground
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the wheel's suspension raycast is currently intersecting a surface.

method.name: get_sustained_mass
method.description: Returns the effective mass in kilograms supported by this wheel, computed from suspension compression. Used by the tire model to determine the friction limit.

method.name: get_compression
method.description: Returns the suspension compression ratio. 0.0 means fully extended (no contact), 1.0 means fully compressed (bottomed out).

method.name: get_self_aligning_torque
method.description: Returns the self-aligning torque in Newton-meters at the steering axis from lateral tire forces. Positive values try to steer the wheel right, negative values try to steer left.

method.name: get_slip_ratio
method.description: Returns the longitudinal slip ratio: [code](tire_speed - road_speed) / road_speed[/code]. 0.0 means pure rolling, 1.0 means spinning freely, negative values indicate braking/locked.

method.name: get_slip_angle
method.description: Returns the lateral slip angle in degrees. 0 means the tire is pointing in its direction of travel; larger values indicate the tire is sliding sideways.

method.name: get_abs_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if ABS is actively modulating brake pressure this physics frame.

method.name: get_is_sliding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the wheel is currently sliding (excessive slip ratio or slip angle).
